name: SNEmulDS 0.6a

commands: "$DEVKITARM/bin/arm-none-eabi-gcc" -c -march=armv5te -mthumb-interwork -o upstream/.dusty-build/ds_arm7_crt0.o upstream/.dusty-build/ds_arm7_crt0.s && "$DEVKITARM/bin/arm-none-eabi-gcc" -c -march=armv5te -mthumb-interwork -o upstream/.dusty-build/ds_arm9_crt0.o upstream/.dusty-build/ds_arm9_crt0.s && cp upstream/.dusty-build/*.o "$DEVKITARM/arm-none-eabi/lib/"

ln -sfn disk/diskstr.h 'upstream/arm9/source/disk\diskstr.h' && ln -sfn mpu/pu.h 'upstream/arm9/source/mpu\pu.h' && ln -sfn pu.h 'upstream/arm9/source/mpu/mpu\pu.h' && ln -sfn ../main.h 'upstream/arm9/source/mpu/..\main.h' && ln -sfn ../opcodes.h 'upstream/arm9/source/mpu/..\opcodes.h'
ln -sfn source/main.h upstream/arm9/main.h && ln -sfn source/opcodes.h upstream/arm9/opcodes.h && ln -sfn nds/memory.h "$DEVKITPRO/libnds/include/nds\memory.h"

notes: Pinned legacy SNEmulDS 0.6a source build using its historical devkitARM linker files and local MPL-2.0 crt0 compatibility sources. Verify argv launch, SNES saves, and DS Lite behavior on hardware.
